_comment: Interiors and fleet ladders, per faction. Driven from a manifest rather than literal calls in __init__.mast so a renamed file fails loudly at load instead of drifting silently. The version is stamped by _stamp.py from __lib__.json, which is the single place to bump it. The Brood ladder climbs by COUNT alone - it has no doctrine, so more of the same thing is the only axis it has.
